architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. Tailwind CSS for styling. React Router for navigation. No state management (useState/useContext only).

tickets.title: Landing page skeleton (src/pages/LandingPage.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React. Extract static assets (images, fonts) to public/. Use Tailwind classes. Preserve exact layout, spacing, typography. Skip animations for now.
acceptance_criteria: All text selectable, all links clickable (placeholder # for now)

tickets.title: Shared UI components (src/components/) from style guide
tickets.description: Extract reusable components: Button, Card, Badge, Header, Footer. Use Tailwind. Props: variant, size, disabled. No logic. Storybook-style showcase in src/components/Showcase.jsx.
acceptance_criteria: Showcase page renders all components with all variants

tickets.title: Component showcase page (src/pages/ComponentShowcase.jsx)
tickets.description: Build page using components from TASK-002. Match component_showcase_buttons_cards layout. Add interactive demo: button click increments counter (no persistence).
acceptance_criteria: All components from TASK-002 visible and functional

tickets.title: Static asset pipeline and Tailwind config
tickets.description: Set up Tailwind. Configure theme to match Stitch design tokens (colors, fonts, spacing). Extract all static assets (images, fonts) to public/. Optimize images (max 1920px width, WebP format).
acceptance_criteria: All Stitch design colors in Tailwind config
Font families match design (Inter, monospace fallback)
No 404s for assets in dev tools

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create App.jsx. Set up React Router with routes: / (LandingPage), /components (ComponentShowcase). Add Header/Footer from TASK-002. Dark/light mode toggle (localStorage persistence).
acceptance_criteria: Dark/light mode toggle persists on refresh
No layout shift on route change
